# Multiple fill-zero loops in the same function scope get unique broadcast variable names.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func ZeroAll(a, b, c []float64) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = 0
	}
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = 0
	}
	for i := range c {
		c[i] = 0
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func ZeroAll(a, b, c []float64) {
	_vcFloat64s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(0)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(a); {
		_n := _vcFloat64s0.StorePart(a[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
	_vcFloat64s1 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(0)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(b); {
		_n := _vcFloat64s1.StorePart(b[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
	_vcFloat64s2 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(0)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(c); {
		_n := _vcFloat64s2.StorePart(c[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 3 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func ZeroAll(a, b, c []float64) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = 0
	}
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = 0
	}
	for i := range c {
		c[i] = 0
	}
}
